sources.entry: HuggingChat - Open-source AI chat interface powered by Hugging Face models. #free

summary.name: HuggingChat
summary.one_liner: HuggingChat is a chat app from Hugging Face that lets you talk with open-source AI models, including an "Omni" mode that automatically picks a model for each request.
use_cases: Letting an automatic router pick a model for a request
Planning ML experiments with ML Intern
Generating images or planning a trip through chat
summary.what_it_does: HuggingChat is a web chat interface powered by open-source AI models hosted through Hugging Face. The Omni option automatically selects a model it considers best for each request. Users can also pick any available open-source model to chat with directly; the page lists 138 models. The page promotes ML Intern, a feature that plans and runs machine learning work, and an MCP option with two entries. The page itself gives few technical details beyond these.
notable: Omni mode automatically picks the best model per request
Access to 138 open-source models from the Hugging Face community
ML Intern feature plans and runs machine learning work (papers, training, spaces, datasets, eval, hub)
caveats: The page does not state usage limits or whether any paid tier exists
Generated content may be inaccurate, as the page notes
